selection: Frozen screen shortlist on full v36 historical valid; three scaffold-fold proxy gains; objective 0.45 valid +0.55 CV mean -0.04 CV SD, require valid gain >0.0002 and CV mean >0 and objective >0.0005. Individual folds may decline.
metric_alignment: AUPRC: rank:map; AUROC: rank:pairwise; Spearman: fit-only 32-level relevance and rank:pairwise; MAE: median reg:quantileerror. Standard-loss chemistry and assay branches provide comparators.
limitations: Historical valid and scaffold folds reused. CV is v36 newer-source fusion over a historical v24 proxy, not full historical ensemble OOF. Other-task supplied assays make prediction conditional. Official aggregate weights/formula unknown; no platform score forecast.
